William W. Carty
Preserved Primary Document • carty-w2.htm
William Washington Carty, the son of William and Elizabeth Carty , was born in Caroline Co., MD on 14 April,
1818
.  He lived all of his life in Caroline Co. MD, dying there on 3 August,
1880
.
Sometime before
1863
, William married Sarah Morgan , the daughter of  William and Annie Sanders Morgan  from Kent Co., DE. After her husband's death in
1800
, Sarah Carter returned to Kent Co., DE were some of her children were already living.
William and Sarah had the following children :
William Eugene "Gene" Carty (b. December
1862
/3) married Maude (Mosley or Ridgway??)
They had the following children:
Howard Carty
Bertha M. Carty
John W. Carty
Gene Carty who married Isabelle Snowden
John N. Carty (b.October
1864
/5) married Elizabeth (CLARK?)

1867
